text: What do these three fields hold?

**What the three fields hold**

| Field | On the shared report | On a team copy today |
|---|---|---|
| `collections` `{ userId, id, name }` | Each **owner**'s personal collections that hold the report | Inherits the owner's entries at copy time; the client then `$push`/`$pull`s them through `bulk-collections` |
| `assignments` | Review assignments for the **owner** (or "System") | Inherits the owner's as is. Nothing writes a copy's own assignments |
| `searchIndex.teamMappings` | Id and name of every team it is assigned to, written by `SyncSearchIndexTeamMappingsReportHandler` | Inherits the list of **every** team (a data leak) |

Also found (not in the ticket): `restore-team-report.handler.ts` restores a soft-deleted copy, then runs `updateMany({...sharedReport})`.
